scope: Private read-only literal CLI campaign auditor. No production/testsource/profile/ledger mutation.

validation.fixtures: Synthetic evidence only, never live acceptance
additional_negatives: missing train/val files plus absent recorded SHA remain false
missing console stub plus absent context/receipt SHA remain false

review.result: original missing-file/None-equality finding closed; no new blocker reported
changes: digest_matches requires both full 64hex SHA values
dataset, pinned sources and console stub use strict digest comparison

retained_history.initial_logs: Both original 12-test logs retained; revision1-fixed log contains the actual 14-test revision.

quality_review.rule: Only exact suite='full' and pytest_arguments=['-q'], exit0/passed, matching before/after source inventories, current supported source hashes and original PLAN. No older metadata inferred equivalent.

safety.Store: Only URI mode=ro, query_only, restricted SQL authorizer, snapshot before/after; old v5 needed no Store access.

output_policy: New exclusive JSON only in reports/ or .cache/setup; existing report never overwritten.
exit_semantics: Auditor exit0 only formal_cli_gate=true; exit1 otherwise. It never launches/retries a run. Real 78/124/1 remain observed nonzero; killed without returned receipt remains unknown.
limitations: No real v6 campaign audited yet.
Only installed_console_script invocation is proved, not separate uv launcher.
Model quality, cost, target and numerical acceptance remain separate original audits.
Profile path is compared opaquely and never read.
All generated files in ignored .cache/setup; no untracked reports or source changes.
